messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: Runtime canary showing p95 latency spike + kernel-fallback churn after deploy (deploy-2026-03-15-1145). region=eu-west-1 service=runtime symptom=latency+throughput-drop. Pager: @sanjay. Incident ID INC-20260315-47

sanjay: Ack, I'm on. Marking incident, grabbing logs and topology. Initial guess: batcher/kernel selector thrashing after the new adaptive-batching flip.

deploy-bot: rollout deploy-2026-03-15-1145 completed at 2026-03-15T15:00:02Z (canary -> 10% traffic).

marta: @sanjay yeah that was me — I promoted adaptive-batching-v2 to canary earlier. I saw small perf wins on staging but not that environment. Reverting now.

marta: Running rollback command:```bash
curl -XPOST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/adaptive-batching-v2/off
# expected propagation ~30s
```

devops: logs from shard-12 around the spike:```
2026-03-15T15:02:13Z runtime[shard-12]: kernel_selector: selected=quantized-kernel fallback=true
2026-03-15T15:02:14Z runtime[shard-12]: metrics: prefetch_evictions=1223 kv_evictions=98 batch_window_ms=18
2026-03-15T15:02:14Z runtime[shard-12]: throughput=0.85rps (baseline 1.0rps)
```

lucy: Quick customer impact: p95 went from ~120ms -> ~620ms for affected slice; throughput dropped ~15%. Error rate (5xx) up marginally (+0.2%). Approx 2% of requests crossed 1s. No customer-facing tickets so far but out-of-band alerts from a partner.

sanjay: Initiating kill-switch to route canary traffic back to baseline model and pause autoscale. oncall-bot, please set routing to stable and hold new canary traffic.

oncall-bot: ACTION: routing policy frozen. Traffic for runtime-canary in eu-west-1 redirected to baseline-model-v1. Autoscale paused for canary pools.

marta: Rollback command returned success at 2026-03-15T15:08:10Z. Flag state=OFF across canary. Confirming artifact versions on nodes.

sanjay: Seeing p95 start to decline in the metric window — 15:11 shows p95 ~210ms. Throughput returning. Keeping shard-level logs under watch for kernel fallback re-occurrence.

devops: Side note — kernel selector logs show repeated fallback due to warm-up latency in quantized path; evictions peaked when batch_window shrank. We'll capture a flamegraph and KV cache stats.

marta: I'm going to open a follow-up with runtime team and runtime SREs: creating ticket PM-2345 (post-incident: investigate adaptive-batching-v2 selector heuristics + canary rollout gating).

lucy: I'll draft a brief customer-impact note for CSMs: minimal customer visible impact, mitigation applied, follow-up scheduled.

sanjay: Handing off to @marta for overnight follow-up and root-cause analysis. I'll stay on call for 20 more minutes then sign out. If it regresses, page me directly. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks — I'll keep the ticket and workspace updated. Planning to repro in a controlled environment tomorrow AM and run kernel-selector stress tests.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated at 2026-03-15T15:12:34Z. Monitoring continues.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) — follow-up required. Action items: 1) runtime team to reproduce selector/flapping, 2) add gating checks to flag promotion pipeline, 3) verify KV cache sizing for canary pools. Owner: marta.

sanjay: Closing my loop here, handing off. Good job team.

marta: Copy — will post a short RCA draft tomorrow and assign owners.
